field.label: Enable GeoIP filtering
field.help: Apply the GeoIP policies below. The country database is downloaded with "Update database" and refreshed weekly.

field.label: Database source URL
field.help: Base URL that serves ip2country-v4.tsv.gz and ip2country-v6.tsv.gz (for example your cloud feed server). Empty uses iptoasn.com (public domain data).
